description: This file implements the RDKWindowManager class, which manages window services within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling for the window manager component, and registers the service with the framework.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle and notifications of the RDK window service within the WPEFramework plugin system.

methods.name: RDKWindowManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the singleton instance and logs startup.

methods.name: ~RDKWindowManager
methods.description: Destructor that logs shutdown and resets the singleton instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the window manager service, registers notifications, and initializes the implementation object.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases references.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
